tex_content.source:
\label{xicomp}

With the later choice of $B$, the short-loop alternative supplies
$t_n\in J_B(c)$ with
\[
L(\widetilde\Gamma_c^{\lambda_n}(t_n))
<e^{-C_2(t_1-t_0)}\zeta/3.
\]
\end{remark}

\begin{lemma}[Sharper single-point estimate for the curve deformation]
